QuestInfo.name: Time for a Change!
QuestInfo.0: #p2151009# is speaking to you. What is it?
QuestInfo.2: #p2151009# finally turned back to normal...until speaking. That didn't last long at all, but #p2151009# seems pleased with even a temporary success.
QuestInfo.1: #p2151009# told you that you could obtain a #r#t04032972##k by eliminating #r#o8200000#s#k in #b#m270000100##k. Mastema seems to think that this Sand Glass can revert appearances through time. If you find one in the Temple of Time, you might as well bring it to Mastema.

0.0: Hey, #h0#. If you're going to #m270000100#, could you do a little something for me?

yes.0: I heard there's a #r#t04032972##k that you can get from #r#o8200000#s#k in #b#m270000100#. #kRegressive Hourglasses can move people back through time, so I thought, hey, that could move me back to my previous form!

no.0: Oh, don't worry, it's really easy. Heh, it's hardly even a favor at all! Just a little thing to keep in mind when you go to the Temple of Time. You don't mind helping, right?

1.0: You brought it! Oh, happy day!

yes.0: Finally...will I finally have my form and my power back? Could it be...?

item.0: I've been waiting for hundreds of years... I can wait a little longer. Take your time. I'll just, y'know, sit here, bored and alone, doing cat-things, like I have for the last few centuries... Remember, it's a #r#t04032972##k from the #r#o8200000#s#k in #b#m270000100##k. ...Please hurry.
